verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs describe Playgrounds as a no-code workspace for rapidly iterating on prompts, models, scorers, and datasets. They also say playgrounds run full evaluations in real time with side-by-side comparison and shareable configurations, which covers the core story. Support for variables is only implied by dataset inputs, not stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompt template variables and their binding, detail on which real model providers the playground calls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground workflow.
